terms.definition: The resistance of the source itself, which causes energy to be transferred inside it when there is a current.
terms.examiner: ℰ = I(R + r); the "lost volts" are Ir.

terms.definition: The p.d. across the terminals of a source when it supplies a current, V = ℰ − Ir.
terms.examiner: From a V–I graph: intercept = e.m.f., gradient = −r.
